answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that signs a periodic liveness proof; standing thaws slowly like permafrost across a frozen tundra, gaining weight only after several already-established peers from separate funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet is a wind-blown dune, every endorsement tracing to one root and never spanning distinct clusters, so clones stay as faint as velvet dust while a farm pays a distinct anchor per head, linear versus honest once.
